reason: Baton primarily provides persistent project memory and handoff workflows for AI-assisted development, storing tasks and project state in Git-tracked files and integrating with several AI coding hosts.

summaries.zh: Baton 将任务、进度、决策和交接信息保存到项目文件中，帮助不同电脑或 AI 编程工具之间延续开发工作。
summaries.en: Baton stores project tasks, progress, decisions, and handoffs in project files to help continue AI-assisted development across computers and coding hosts.

capabilities: Stores project tasks, progress, decisions, lessons, and handoffs in project files
Adds AI host skills, rules, and configuration files during installation or initialization
Reads and updates Git-tracked project memory
Can perform documented Git workflows including commit and push through AI commands
Supports installation, update, repair, and doctor-style checks across Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, and DeepSeek Harness
